submission.justification: Mixture-G2 with a 2.0 mm gas gap achieves the best time resolution of 0.878 ns among all tested configurations. Systematic simulations across the allowed gap range (1-3 mm) for all three candidate mixtures show that Mixture-G2 consistently outperforms the alternatives, with G1 achieving 1.358 ns and G3 achieving 2.048 ns at their respective optimal gaps (both also at 2.0 mm). The 2.0 mm gap represents the optimal point for G2, showing better performance than both smaller (0.978 ns at 1.0 mm) and larger (0.923 ns at 2.5 mm, 1.046 ns at 3.0 mm) gaps. All mixtures are available from suppliers, compatible with the HV system (up to 12 kV), and will be used with a 90% recovery closed-loop recirculation system to minimize environmental impact. This recommendation meets all constraints while maximizing detector performance.
